n40a27e31b8.headline: Euro zone economy growth hits highest in decade
n40a27e31b8.summary: Growth in the euro zone surged in 2017 to levels not seen since before the financial crisis, signaling a strong regional economic recovery.
n40a27e31b8.why: The euro zone is a major global economic bloc; its growth rates influence global trade, investment flows, and monetary policy expectations.
n40a27e31b8.why_moved: Stronger-than-expected euro zone growth boosts investor confidence in European markets and the euro currency.
